items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: Eddie Vance and Jimmy Paul... Eddie Vance and Jimmy Paul, Big Eye Louie and Freddie Kepard.

ctx.x: It was about the time of the storm then, huh? Approximately, roughly. Well, let me see. What was the first band to leave here and go into the North? Into the North? That you remember.
Eddie Vance and Jimmy Paul. Let me see what band they call that.
We can figure it out. Who else was in the band?
